manifest.eval_policy: frozen copies of full live checkpoint; no hidden/world reset; IID additionally hidden-reset every512; new-regime postfork matured requests primary; inherited,carryover,censored separate
manifest.B_source: each seed online128 final A checkpoint; same complete model/Adam/h/world/RNG/replay
manifest.B_policy: own actions, current-world causal oracle loss; preserve h/world at distribution change
manifest.replay_origin: finite uniform reservoir of actual A observations, teacher labels and historical start_h; no B/test additions
manifest.budget_limit: repeat/replay equal gradient passes, replay has64 extra no-grad burnin steps per chunk; not equal forward FLOPs
manifest.primary_claim: effect of continuous state on same live environment, boundary-straddling requests and long waiting; parameter scale and training-policy comparisons factorized
manifest.pilot: seed101 512updates c128/reset128/online128 with mixed clocks used to validate plumbing; pilot independent of formal seeds
manifest.clock_choice: main constant .25 decouples state cuts from clock transitions and gives GRU a simpler timing distribution
manifest.hardware: shared GPU with concurrent workers; elapsed timings include contention, not isolated speed benchmarks
limits: TBPTT64 detaches gradients but keeps values; not unlimited temporal credit
fixed-size learned controller, oracle supervision, not autonomous reward-only learning
evaluation forks never overwrite live learner
checkpoint restart pauses simulated time; no claim of computation while process is stopped
